ideas.title: Healthcare Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigating allegations of healthcare fraud in Minnesota, including a Medicaid operator and a urologist in the Trump administration
ideas.angle: Following the money and exploring connections between entities
ideas.insight: This story could expose a larger scheme to defraud the healthcare system, potentially involving multiple entities and officials.

ideas.title: Elections Investigation in Wisconsin
ideas.description: Exploring the FBI's expanded investigation into 2020 election interference in Wisconsin
ideas.angle: Investigating potential connections between election officials and outside entities
ideas.insight: This story could reveal a larger scheme to interfere with elections, potentially involving multiple entities and officials.
